title: An error budget needs a declared event population
method: Synthetic request SLO: (1−0.995)×200,000=1,000 allowed bad events; 1,000−650=350 remaining. A rolling window changes with future traffic; not a time-based downtime allowance.
alt: An error budget needs a declared event population: Allowed bad events 1000 requests, Already consumed 650 requests, Remaining 350 requests. Illustrative inputs.
